_comment: Error-count ceilings for type checkers that are not yet clean. Read by scripts/check_error_ceiling.py. ok_exit_codes lists the exit codes that mean the checker finished (clean or with ordinary errors); any other code fails the gate. A ceiling may only go down: when you fix errors, lower the number to the new count in the same change. Never raise one to make a build pass; fix the new error instead.
